texto:
Katelyn Lesse and Angela Jiang join Latent Space to explain the engineering behind the Claude Platform: launching Opus 5.5, separating the model’s “brain” from the agent’s “hands,” scaling APIs, and building reliable managed agents.
A new introduction covers Anthropic’s S-1, the improvement and investment loops, and why the platform matters.
Show notes
Claude Opus 5.5 — Anthropic’s launch notes on model behavior, evaluation and pricing.
Scaling Managed Agents — Decoupling the brain, harness and sandbox.
How Anthropic contains Claude — Isolation, credentials and network controls.
Effective harnesses for long-running agents — Maintaining progress across context windows.
Our Anthropic S-1 breakdown — Context for the newly recorded introduction.
